operators.name: custom_relu
semantics: Computes elementwise max(x, 0) for each element, preserving dtype, device, shape, and stride/layout
Corresponds to reference statement x = torch.relu(x)

operators.name: custom_gelu

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference input after relu [64, 1, 2048, 2048]

semantics: Computes elementwise Gaussian Error Linear Unit (nn.GELU(), exact erf-based) for each element: 0.5 * x * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2)))
Preserves dtype, device, shape, and stride/layout
Corresponds to reference statement x = nn.GELU()(x)
Preserves dtype torch.float32, device cuda, shape [64, 1, 2048, 2048], stride [4194304, 4194304, 2048, 1]
Elementwise exact GELU (nn.GELU(), default approximate='none'): output[i] = 0.5 * x[i] * (1 + erf(x[i] / sqrt(2)))
Preserves dtype torch.float32, device cuda, shape [64, 1, 2048, 2048], stride [4194304, 4194304, 2048, 1]
Returns the tensor after GELU, same dtype, device, shape, stride as step_002
